title: Our SMPD Family: An Inspiring Talk with Sgt. Elaina Hassan & K9 Jack (Thanksgiving Special)
description:
​👮‍♀️ A Look Inside the Badge: Sgt. Elaina Hassan & K9 Jack's Story (Thanksgiving Special)

​This Thanksgiving week, we're taking a moment to celebrate the family that supports our Santa Monica Police Department (SMPD) and introducing you to one of our finest: Sergeant Elaina Hassan.

​In this exclusive interview, Sgt. Hassan opens up about her journey: from her college days and early career in Arizona to finding her true professional home here at the SMPD. She shares what inspired her to serve and the powerful role her family plays in her demanding career.

​🌟 What You'll See in This Video:
​The Journey to SMPD: Hear about her well-rounded background, including her education in Arizona, and why she chose to join the Santa Monica Police Department.

​The Passion for Travel: Discover Sgt. Hassan's love for exploring and how that broad perspective informs her work in our community.

​More Than a Partner: Hear the heartwarming story of her bond with K9 Jack, and why he is truly considered part of her immediate family.

​We are incredibly grateful for the dedication of Sgt. Hassan, K9 Jack, and the entire SMPD team. Wishing everyone in our community a safe and happy holiday!
